overview_description.description: Traceforce provides an on-device security and control platform for browser-based AI, desktop AI applications, and CLI agents. The platform inventories AI applications, MCPs, and skills, monitors prompts and tool calls, detects vulnerabilities, automatically remediates affected packages, and blocks dangerous runtime actions. Traceforce also provides TraceGraph for linking prompts, tool calls, and outcomes during incident investigation, along with the open-source mcp-xray tool for testing MCP security.
